sourceNotes.rawContent:
A warm, golden-toned gift hamper made to celebrate real friendship. Packed in a white gift box with a "Best Friends Forever" ribbon and a heartfelt "Happy Friendship Day" card — this hamper is a full jewellery collection for the friend who deserves it all.
What's Inside:
- Gold-Tone Stud & Hoop Earrings Set (6 Pairs)
- Gold-Tone Textured Hoop Earrings
- Peach & Pearl Beaded Flower Charm Bracelet
- Gold-Tone Twisted Ring
- Satin Fabric Rose Hair Tie – Ivory
- Acrylic Flower Hair Claw Clip – Yellow
-
Why She'll Love It:
- A complete jewellery set — 7 pairs of earrings, ring & bracelet in one box
- Elegant gold-tone finish that goes with everyday and festive wear
- Perfect for Friendship Day, birthdays, or a heartfelt thank-you gift
Note: Cash on Delivery (COD) is not available for this hamper. Prepaid orders only.
